description: This file contains an abstract base class for testing Azure Storage persistence providers within the Orleans framework. It defines inner configurator classes for silo and client configuration, and sets up the testing environment with a specific namespace.

classes.name: Base_PersistenceGrainTests_AzureStore
classes.description: Abstract base class for orchestrating persistence provider tests with Azure Storage in Orleans.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Storage clustering with test defaults.

classes.name: ClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder to connect to Azure Storage clustering with test defaults.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder or IClientBuilder instance to use Azure Storage clustering with default test options.

methods.name: Base_PersistenceGrainTests_AzureStore
methods.description: Constructor initializing the base test class with output helper, fixture, and optional grain namespace.
